spotlight.name: Domios
spotlight.summary: Domios is a distributed OS for AI agents: the place where Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and local models live, work and coordinate as one team. It's not a terminal with AI bolted on. It's the infrastructure agents need, wrapped in a terminal because that's where developers already work. Andrey conceived it and builds it every day, with agents doing the work under his review.

proof.title: Domios is built inside Domios.
proof.body: One engineer, seven months, a desktop OS for Windows, macOS and Linux. Andrey sets the goal; an Orchestrator splits it into tasks, Workers build them in isolated lanes, and nothing merges until it has been reviewed. The tool is its own strongest case study.

differences.title: An OS for agents, not an AI terminal
differences.body: A CLI and API every agent can use: open a tab, read output, spawn a worker, send a message, without knowing the host's internals.

differences.title: Meta-teams that ship reviewed work
differences.body: An Orchestrator coordinates and verifies, a Planner shapes each task and gives its Worker a fitting personality, and Workers implement. A plan tracks progress, and review separates a submitted result from an accepted one.

differences.title: Any agent, side by side
differences.body: Model- and provider-agnostic. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and local models share one workspace through provider plugins.

differences.title: A spinal cord that keeps work moving
differences.body: Small, bounded judgments name each tab's state and recover stuck work while nobody watches. The model names the state; deterministic evidence authorizes the action.

capabilities.title: Teams and plans
capabilities.body: Give a goal, get tasks, isolated work lanes, reports and reviewed results.

capabilities.title: Shared memory
capabilities.body: Agents on one machine share facts, decisions and skills in a searchable knowledge graph. Dreams consolidates it.

capabilities.title: Mesh
capabilities.body: Pair your computers and send commands, agents and reports between them.

capabilities.title: Desktop to phone
capabilities.body: Continue with the same agents from your phone over your private Tailnet.

capabilities.title: Telegram bridge
capabilities.body: Message your agents and get replies and notifications wherever you are.

capabilities.title: Schedules and sessions
capabilities.body: Recurring agent jobs, plus searching and resuming any past conversation.

spotlight.openSource: Domios is open source under AGPL-3.0. Download it, run it, read the code, or build on it.
